DitherScrambleText.trigger: mount plays on its own, hover plays when the pointer enters, change plays only when text changes, manual plays when you call replay(). Every trigger also plays when text changes.
DitherScrambleText.mode: dither is a block, then glyphs, then the letter. blocks is only the block. glyphs is only glyphs.
DitherScrambleText.ink: Colour of the blocks and glyphs.
DitherScrambleText.stagger: The time between one character starting and the next.
DitherScrambleText.delay: The time before the first character starts.
DitherScrambleText.rate: Glyph changes per second while a character is unsettled.
DitherScrambleText.cell: Size of one dither cell in a block.
DitherScrambleText.completed: Called when every character has settled.
DitherScrambleText.replay: Plays the effect again from the start.
